text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...You two really can't remember what<n>today is?
That forgetful, huh?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And... you're so busy you don't have<n>time to make
memories with<n>Machan... I see.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I guess there's nothing to be done<n>about it then...
I'll just go back to my<n>room...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ahh! I'm just not cut out for this! We<n>can drop it,
right, Scarlet?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
We wanted to throw you a surprise<n>party, but we
didn't get everything<n>ready in time... Sorry, it'll just
be a<n>little longer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Vodka, Scarlet... This is amazing! I<n>couldn't be
happier!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Not only did you remember my<n>birthday, you
planned a party just for<n>me...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that would make a great video. Do<n>you think
you could do that again, on<n>camera this time?
